name: HoneycombLens
job: Lay out many photos as a honeycomb where cells near the pointer swell like a fisheye lens while the rest recede
visitor_action: hover/drag across the grid; tap a cell to open it; arrow keys move between photos, Enter opens one
mobile: fixed 3-wide grid, drag across to magnify, tap opens
motion: cells scale by distance to the pointer with smooth spring (reduced-motion: uniform grid, hover outline only)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: CSS entrance stuck invisible in the 375 iframe, replaced by lens bloom; partial last row broke the hex lattice)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Apiary: honey-amber cell edges, beeswax cream ground, dark-bark captions, matte wax texture
notes: Photos show blank in the 375 headless-iframe shot (lazy images; the shipped ContactSheetGallery does the same), and a partial last row sits left-weighted on the lattice.
